onboarding.intro: Follow the shared onboarding flow: confirm the runtime, pair this dashboard, connect to the gateway, and finish in an operator-ready state.

runtime.title: Runtime available
runtime.description: Reach a usable local Corvus runtime or gateway for this dashboard.

trust.title: Trust this surface
trust.description: Exchange a pairing code once to receive the bearer token for this dashboard.

connect.title: Connect to gateway
connect.description: Validate the admin transport with the current bearer token and gateway URL.

ready.title: Ready for operator tasks
ready.description: Load configuration and continue with dashboard management work.

ready.title: Operator-ready
ready.description: The dashboard completed pairing and gateway connection. You can now manage Corvus safely from this surface.

runtime_unavailable.title: Runtime unavailable
runtime_unavailable.description: The dashboard could not reach the local Corvus runtime. Start the runtime and retry the connection step.

transport_unavailable.title: Surface transport unavailable
transport_unavailable.description: The dashboard reached an unexpected transport failure. Verify the gateway URL and retry safely.

trust_input_invalid.title: Pairing code invalid
trust_input_invalid.description: The pairing code was rejected. Request a valid pairing code from the runtime and pair again.

trust_input_expired.title: Pairing code expired
trust_input_expired.description: The pairing code is no longer valid. Generate a new pairing code and repeat the trust step.

credential_missing.title: Bearer token missing
credential_missing.description: This dashboard is not authenticated yet. Pair this surface to receive a bearer token before connecting.

credential_invalid.title: Bearer token invalid or revoked
credential_invalid.description: The stored bearer token no longer works. The dashboard cleared the stale token; pair again to continue.

paired_but_not_connected.title: Paired but not connected
paired_but_not_connected.description: Trust is established, but the dashboard could not complete the authenticated gateway check. Retry the connection step.
